svg.aria-label: What I got wrong. BEATMIND · GPU: believed The GPU was doing the work.; measured It had silently fallen back to the CPU. One missing library, libcublasLt.so.13.; so Fixed it. About a minute became 23 seconds (two different tracks, so “about”). BEATMIND · RIGHTS: believed A tick box saying “I own this” is enough.; measured A checkbox is not a rights check.; so Deleted it. Export now needs a fingerprint match. BEATMIND · BILLING · 2026-09-20: believed Refunds on a downgrade were fair.; measured They refunded cash for credits already spent.; so Found it fact-checking one sentence for a client. Fixed the same day. VIVID · SPEED: believed A turbo model, 5.9× cheaper, was a win.; measured Faces got worse and people were duplicated.; so Did not ship it. UPI FRAUD ENGINE · JAN 2026: believed 0.9106 ROC-AUC. Ready to go.; measured A column that only existed in my synthetic data matched the label 100%.; so Removed it and retrained. 0.8953 is the honest number. QUERYPILOT: believed A hallucination rate of 100%.; measured My detector was reading dictionary keys, not table names. The real rate was 0%.; so Fixed the detector.
